description: Debt service coverage before and after a new loan, and the largest loan the cash flow carries at a target ratio. Cash flow is net income plus interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, and adjustments. A calculation only: a lender sets its own minimum.

adjust.description: Other yearly adjustments in dollars, negative allowed (optional)

da.description: Yearly depreciation and amortization in dollars (optional)

debts.description: Yearly payments on existing debt in dollars (optional)

months.description: New loan term in months, 1 to 360

name: calculate_debt_service_coverage
title: Debt service coverage ratio
